title: AI 问询首页 T5: the 「设计布局」 menu designer offers an "AI 问询" singleton entry (`ai:chat`) with a small copy form; "设为首页" moves it to the first position
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwGVgec21LwQTtRY85

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Source: maintainer — the AI 问询首页 plan ordered 「立卡派发」 (2026-11-27 02:37Z, quoted in #37788's body), handed to seat repo:objectstack#1 by epic:#5027#1 (mailbox comment 7209013967: "file them when you take the line") and taken on Elon's tap 「全接,开新专区」 (accepted 7210179549). Scope rows: #37788 comment 7210202110 (Fable review §4, copied verbatim by hotlong).
Grading: area:ai · Feature · priority:p2 (follow-on of #37788, p1; T3 #37790 is p2) · size M · reach: every app whose maker uses 「设计布局」 to add the AI inquiry page.
Dedupe: open-issue search `"DesignModeMenu" ai:chat`: 1 hit (#37788); `"设计布局" "AI 问询"`: 1 hit (#37788). Neither files a designer entry.
Blocked-by: #37788

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：「设计布局」里加一种菜单项「AI 问询」，一个应用只能有一个；小表单填欢迎标题、副标题、输入框提示和推荐问题；「设为首页」就是把它移到菜单第一位。
- 为什么等 #37788：页面本身在 #37788，页面没合并前就能在设计器里加这个菜单项，用户会点到一个不存在的页面。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Scope (from #37788 comment 7210202110; `AS` = `ui/packages/app-shell/src`)
- Files: `AS/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx`, `AS/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts`, i18n `designMode.menu.kind`.
- The picker gains 「AI 问询」 as a **singleton** (like "链接", it lists no existing items; once the app has one `ai:chat` entry it is no longer offered).
- A small form edits title, subtitle, placeholder and suggestions, validated by `AiChatNavParamsSchema` (exported from `@objectstack/spec/ui` since #37787 merged; component ref `AI_CHAT_COMPONENT_REF`; at most one such entry per app).
- "设为首页" = move the item to the first navigation position; do **not** write `landing` (`landing` entries require `visible`, and "same home for everyone" is the first nav item: `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1603-1611`, :1645-1650 at objectstack `da31daff`; re-read on main at claim).

## Evidence (read at objectstack `da31daff`; re-measure at claim)
- Picker kinds today: object / view / dashboard / report / page / url (`DesignModeMenu.tsx:990-995`); entries can only be renamed and re-iconed, "who can see it" stays in Studio (`DesignModeMenu.tsx:13-16`, :66-68).
- `entryFor` has no `component` branch (`designModeMenuModel.ts:330-349`).
- The save writes the whole app document: the own package when writable, else `.custom` (`AS/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts:5-15`).

## Acceptance
- On an installed app the entry saves into `.custom` and is visible to everyone after publish.
- The kind is not offered once the app has an `ai:chat` entry; the form rejects what `AiChatNavParamsSchema` rejects.
- "设为首页" reorders only; no `landing` key is written.
